system.description:
Fortitude Amp

You are under a bond of blood. You gain the following benefits;

Bonded Ally. You can sense the direction of the other creature with the matching Crimson Pact so long as they are within 10 miles of you. You also become aware if they are dead, without chakra or have Physical conditions.

Blood of my Blood. While within 60 feet of your matching Crimson Pact, if either of you regain hit points as a result of a Jutsu’s casting, the other creature gains temporary hit points equal to the result of Hit points gained, which last for 1 minute.

Bonded Lifeforce. If you fall to 0 hit points, your matching Crimson Pact can reduce their maximum hit points by 20 until you both complete a long rest. If they do, you instead fall to 20 hit points.
system.summary: A blood bond with one ally: you sense each other and share jutsu healing as temp HP. Either can lower max HP to keep the other up at 20 HP.

rules.text: Formed over a long rest with a willing creature; both of you get this Amp. Ends when dismissed, on death, or when dispelled (B-Rank or lower).
